chunks: Then We brought the others to that place.

key_terms.أَزْلَفْنَا: We brought near / We caused to approach

ai.seo_question: Who are the 'others' mentioned in Surah Al-Shu'ara verse 64?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the Day of Judgment where God brings forward the 'others'—distinct from the primary recipients of the message—to witness the consequences of their denial. It underscores the divine justice that gathers all factions, including the poets and their followers, to the place of reckoning, highlighting the inevitability of divine retribution for those who follow vain rhetoric over truth.
